title: Settings
languageHint: Changes apply immediately. Agent messages and code stay in their original language.
reduceMotionHint: Keeps work indicators but stops decorative particles and idle sway.
historyHint: Observed sessions and events are kept on this Mac for 14 days so the log and task list survive restarts.
notifyAttention: Notify when an agent needs approval or fails
notifyAttentionHint: macOS notification while Agentville isn't the active window. Demo characters never notify.
soundHint: Short chimes for approval, done and failure. Off by default.
